author: Mark Atwood
text: Idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — crate is generally idiomatic (#[non_exhaustive] universal, no unsafe, no production unwrap/expect, manual impls only where derive would be wrong); five rusty findings filed (JMAP-ly0n.20-.24) are all P2/P3 type-design polish (sha256-newtype, stringly-typed push config, sender_id drift, missing Default on all-Option struct, Display/Serialize duplication). Zero soundness findings, zero unsafe findings, zero clippy-level findings worth flagging — the crate passes clippy --all-features at HEAD per workspace AGENTS.md pre-commit gate.
